name: snap-vm-old01-osdisk
costSource: estimated (LRS snapshot list price, uksouth; upper bound, provisioned GiB, Retail Prices API)
reason: Snapshot is 150 days old (incremental); source disk was deleted, may be the only copy
suggestedAction: The source disk is gone or this is Azure Backup data. Confirm the data is not needed. Check whether a retention policy requires it. If not, delete it. If it must be kept, make sure it's incremental on Standard storage.

name: vm-retired-app_OsDisk
idleSource: no VM CPU data in 90 days (90+)
costSource: estimated (P30 minus E30 LRS list price, eastus, Retail Prices API)
reason: Premium SSD attached to VM vm-retired-app, which has been deallocated for 90+ days (no CPU data). The disk still bills at its full Premium tier
suggestedAction: While the VM stays deallocated, switch the disk to Standard SSD and switch it back before starting the VM. If the VM is retired, snapshot what you need and delete the VM and its disks.
